style_authority.note: Separates adaptive product semantics and shared DESIGN roles from platform-native navigation, controls, typography, materials, motion, and layout.

reference_selection.note: Applies product, iOS, Android, adaptive layout, accessibility, interaction-physics, motion, design-system, and runtime-validation guidance.

anti_generic_redesign.note: Repairs native trust, task flow, accessibility, adaptivity, theming, and interruption resilience without decorative generic styling.

evidence_level.note: Labels the review L0 static and explicitly denies source, build, Simulator, Emulator, accessibility-tree, device, and performance evidence.

verified_boundary.note: Confines verified facts to the supplied description and separately lists unknown contrast, accessibility, gestures, windowing, recovery, performance, and hardware behavior.

design_moves.note: Provides eight concrete moves spanning native navigation, adaptive layouts, controls, targets, scalable type, semantic tokens, accessible motion, recovery, and parity.

scope_control.note: Uses 137 logical lines, exactly five blockers and eight moves, and remains focused on native UI conformance and decisive source, build, and runtime validation.
